flakeFix.cause: the test waited on node.connections, which the proxy node increments when it accepts the CONNECT, before the probe reads the response and calls record_health; the group status then fell back to the pinned alive=true default (MemberHealth alive=true, delay=None) and the later 204 looked like the registered expected-status
flakeFix.fix: wait on the recorded /shared outcome (member 'only' dead) and keep the CONNECT count only as an additional >=2 guard; a regression to the later 204 now times out with the status printed instead of flaking
flakeFix.evidence: before: 5/15 runs failed under 8 busy processes; after: 16/16 + 12/12 single runs and 4/4 full groups suites (32/32) passed under the same load; the final wait requires both the recorded /shared outcome and the two CONNECTs
